t: What he said to three men who had raised the bar
a: أَنْتُمُ الَّذِينَ قُلْتُمْ كَذَا وَكَذَا أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَخْشَاكُمْ لِلَّهِ وَأَتْقَاكُمْ لَهُ
p: Antumu-lladhīna qultum kadhā wa kadhā. Amā wa-Llāhi innī la-akhshākum lillāhi wa atqākum lah
m: Are you the ones who said such and such? By Allah, I am the one among you with the most awe of Allah and the most mindful of Him.
